headline: GERMANY AND RUSSIA SIGN NON-AGGRESSION PACT IN MOSCOW; SECRET CLAUSES REPORTED
dispatch: Soviet Foreign Minister Vyacheslav Molotov and German Foreign Minister Joachim von Ribbentrop signed a ten-year non-aggression treaty in Moscow on the night of August 23, 1939. The pact stunned European capitals that had been negotiating their own alliances with Moscow. Diplomatic sources in Berlin and Paris indicated the treaty contained secret protocols dividing eastern Europe into German and Soviet spheres, sharply raising fears of an imminent German move against Poland.
answer: Nazi Germany and USSR sign the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact, 1939
